description: Synthesized 3D splat rendering of terrain hexons with Mesh/Splats/Hybrid view modes; phase 2 pre-bakes splat buffers into hexon archives
notes: requested 2026-07-11 ('if easy and convenient'). Scoped to synthesized splats (per-texel from elevation+satellite) — photogrammetric 3DGS training impossible from single orthographic tile imagery. Phase 1 runtime synthesis + view modes; phase 2 hexon pre-bake (additive entry type) + gis-tile-etl bake stage. Implementation queued behind terrain_scale_controls (same crates).
